title: Quarterly review be like 🏢
description:
Quarterly review be like. Bubbles stands on his chair and points a tiny laser pointer at a slide full of upward-pointing charts, while adults nod too eagerly.

"Sales are up. Naps are down. Unacceptable." — Bubbles

Bubbles the Baby CEO: A baby. A boardroom. Zero patience for meetings.
Follow for a new episode every day.
